# aip-whole-request-compression-and-retrieval — task plan

**S1 — Know, measured, which request edits keep the provider prompt cache hitting, for thread and stateless clients (complete)**
- [x] passive: Per-thread table from capture_response: input, cache-read and cache-creation tokens per turn, over at least 3 sessions, answering whether thread history bills as cache reads
  - check: research-record-audit
- [ ] table: Per edit kind (active arm): cache tokens read on turns 2..n, baseline vs edited, with model, date and request ids
  - check: research-record-audit
- [ ] control: A deliberately non-deterministic rewrite shows the cache miss, proving the probe can see one
  - check: probe output; if the control hits the cache, no result is quoted

**S2 — A prompt-caching strategy per known provider, plus a universal fallback for any other provider (complete)**
- [x] per-provider: One strategy per known provider, each stating cache key, min length, TTL, invalidators and the allowed rewrites, with source URL, date and evidence grade
  - check: research-record-audit
- [x] fallback: A universal fallback strategy that applies to any provider not in the catalog, with the rule for choosing it
  - check: owner-gate-review
- [x] testable: Each strategy names the test that proves a cache-breaking rewrite is refused for that provider and for the fallback
  - check: design-tests

**S3 — Score rtk's CCR preview with retrieval allowed, so ccr-design compares like with like (complete)**
- [x] scored: Per-kind table for CCR with retrieval: retention, compression, latency with round trip, retrieval rate, same payloads and questions as the no-retrieval run
  - check: research-record-audit
- [x] tool-cost: Per-request cost of the injected retrieval tool definition stated against the measured saving
  - check: research-record-audit

**S4 — A design for recoverable compression: a head+tail preview plus a retrieval tool answered inside the request (complete)**
- [x] adr: ADR proposed covering preview format, retrieval tool contract, in-request loop under streaming and thread continuation, eviction behavior
  - check: owner-gate-review
- [x] tests: Test list with failure modes and mutations, including a streamed response that calls retrieval
  - check: design-tests

**S5 — A design for compressing every region of a request without breaking the prompt cache (pending)**
- [ ] adr: ADR proposed and ruled per region kind by the owner, stating thread vs stateless handling and which cache strategy governs each provider
  - check: owner-gate-review
- [ ] tests: Test list where each row names the failure mode and the mutation that proves it (incl. byte-stability across turns for re-sent regions)
  - check: design-tests

**S6 — The pipeline compresses every region kind the ADR approved, byte-stable across turns (pending)**
- [ ] stable: Replaying turn n then n+1 yields identical compressed bytes for every region already sent
  - check: dotnet test; mutation: make compression depend on position goes red
- [ ] schemas: Compressed tool definitions still validate as JSON Schema
  - check: dotnet test
- [ ] fallback: A request to a provider outside the catalog is compressed under the universal fallback strategy, not left without one
  - check: dotnet test; mutation: remove the fallback selection goes red
- [ ] latency: Added latency per region kind reported from capture_response stages (p50/p95)
  - check: research record

**S7 — ai-proxy replaces large regions with a recoverable preview and answers retrieval calls in-request (pending)**
- [ ] roundtrip: A request whose tool result was previewed gets the original back when the model calls retrieval, and the client sees one response
  - check: integration test via FakeUpstream; mutation: skip interception goes red
- [x] deterministic: Same original yields identical preview bytes across turns and restarts
  - check: dotnet test

**S8 — Settle whether canonical provider hosts need subdomain matching (complete)**
- [x] listed: Each provider's documented API hosts listed with source URL, and catalog changed or deliberately left exact
  - check: doc review; if changed, ProviderHostCatalogTests red first

**S9 — Whole-request compression and recoverable compression work together through the proxy without breaking the prompt cache (pending)**
- [ ] e2e: Thread and stateless end-to-end tests pass with all approved regions compressed and a retrieval round trip answered in-request
  - check: dotnet test; mutation: a non-deterministic preview turns the cache assertion red
- [ ] cache: Turns 2..n read the cache within the tolerance cache-stability-probe set, apart from the one logged miss when compression switches on
